rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when “national” means covering or existing throughout the whole country.

example.english: The national transport network was expanded this year.
example.traditional: 全國嘅交通網絡今年擴建咗。
example.jyutping: cyun4 gwok3 ge3 gaau1 tung1 mong5 lok3 gam1 nin4 kwok3 gin3 zo2

rows.note: Use this for the slice of sense 0 meaning official or institutional national-level status, not simply nationwide coverage.

example.english: This museum has been upgraded to a national cultural-heritage protection unit.
example.traditional: 呢間博物館升格做國家級文物保護單位喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 bok3 mat6 gun2 sing1 gaak3 zou6 gwok3 gaa1 kap1 man4 mat6 bou2 wu6 daan1 wai2 laa3

rows.meaning: of a nation; characteristic of a country
rows.note: Use this for something belonging to or characteristic of a particular country rather than another one.

example.english: This is an important national symbol.
example.traditional: 呢個係國家嘅重要標誌。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 zung6 jiu3 biu1 zi3
